summary: Continue venv cleanup with partial observations

delivery.outcome: Venv cleanup continues across fully observed projects and reports candidates independently; errors protect only the affected project or environment, while inaccessible process fields do not suppress usable process paths or unrelated scan results.
nonGoals: No cleanup is executed on user projects during implementation.
No candidate with a project or environment tree observation error, recent activity, symlink, missing virtualenv marker, or known active process is removed.
No claim that process observations provide a complete history of use.

architecture.decision: Observe process fields independently, aggregate errors as partial-observation diagnostics, keep filesystem errors scoped to the affected tree, report partial results honestly in the CLI, and revalidate each selected project before deletion.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-054 source and regression-test changes.

commands: OneDev protected CI and independent Validator against the frozen exact head
